name: 上海交通大学
character: The large Minhang campus sits near the Huangpu River, divided by an expressway, with Siyuan Lake beside the southern teaching buildings.

landmarks.name: 思源湖
landmarks.quote: 南部建有三座教学楼，其侧为思源湖
landmarks.look: Plain lake beside three teaching buildings.
